New York: In a report revealed to investors on Thursday morning, Baird reconfirmed their Outperform rating on Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) shares. They now have a $185 PT on the firm. Baird’s target means a potential upside of 30.11 % from the company’s last stock price. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) Ratings Coverage
Among 17 analysts covering Apple ( NASDAQ:AAPL ), 9 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 8 Hold. Therefore 53% are positive. Apple has $310 highest and $165 lowest target. $223.81’s average target is 57.40% above currents $142.19 stock price. Apple had 37 analyst reports since July 23, 2018 according to SRatingsIntel. On Thursday, December 6 the stock rating was maintained by Rosenblatt with “Neutral”. HSBC downgraded it to “Hold” rating and $200 target in Tuesday, December 4 report. The stock has “Overweight” rating by Morgan Stanley on Thursday, November 8. The stock of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has “Outperform” rating given on Friday, November 2 by Robert W. Baird. BMO Capital Markets maintained it with “Market Perform” rating and $213 target in Friday, November 2 report. The firm earned “Buy” rating on Tuesday, August 21 by Bank of America. Citigroup maintained it with “Buy” rating and $230 target in Thursday, August 2 report. The rating was maintained by Canaccord Genuity with “Buy” on Wednesday, August 1.
The stock decreased 9.96% or $15.73 during the last trading session, reaching $142.19. About 90.62 million shares traded or 116.42% up from the average. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 0.17% since January 3, 2018 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 0.17% the S&P500.
Analysts await Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) to report earnings on February, 7. They expect $4.74 EPS, up 21.85 % or $0.85 from last year’s $3.89 per share. AAPL’s profit will be $22.49 billion for 7.50 P/E if the $4.74 EPS becomes a reality. After $2.91 actual EPS reported by Apple Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 62.89 % EPS growth.
Apple Inc. designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, personal computers, and portable digital music players to consumers, small and mid-sized businesses, and education, enterprise, and government clients worldwide. The company has market cap of $674.75 billion. The firm also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications. It has a 11.94 P/E ratio. It offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers.
